body.statement: For every \(n\ge3\), every support law of \(\Pi_h^\star\) belongs to \(\mathcal P_{n,n,\epsilon,M,\sigma_n^\star}\), the two design marginals are identical, and their ATE intervals are the singletons \(\{-\Delta_n^\star\}\) and \(\{\Delta_n^\star\}\). For the full-sample mixtures \(\mathbb Q_h^\star:=\int Q_P^{(n)}\,d\Pi_h^\star(P)\), the sign test based on \(\overline Z_n\) gives \[\operatorname{TV}(\mathbb Q_{-1}^\star,\mathbb Q_1^\star)\ge1-2\exp\!\left\{-\frac{n(\Delta_n^\star)^2}{2M^2}\right\}=1-2\exp\!\left\{-\frac{\log^2(en)}{32\log^2(e+\log^2(en))}\right\}.\] Hence this exactly normalized supportwise-radius family violates the required mixture-distance bound for all sufficiently large \(n\); the failed condition is full-mixture indistinguishability, caused by its hypothesis-wide outcome shift.
